conditions: 논문의 처치·결과 정의와 대상 기업의 변수 정의가 일치할 것
논문의 모집단·시기·제도 및 효과 발생 시차가 적용 대상과 부합할 것

원자료 R07573의 적용 맥락: This paper reports a randomized evaluation (2015–2018) of International Care Ministries’ Transform program in the Philippines. From February–May 2015 ICM delivered Values (evangelical Protestant theology), Health, and Livelihood modules to ultra‑poor households across 320 communities chosen by 160 pastors; outcomes were surveyed ~6 months (Aug 2015–Jan 2016) and ~30 months (Nov 2017–Jun 2018) after program end. The unit of analysis is targeted households/invitees with community‑level random assignment (paired by pastor) to identify causal effects of intentionally generated religiosity on economic outcomes.
